<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="tinderGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="keyShadow" x="-10%" y="-10%" width="120%" height="130%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="1" stdDeviation="0" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity=".18"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="20" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
    <line x1="327" y1="15" x2="327" y2="19" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="332" y1="12" x2="332" y2="19" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="337" y1="9" x2="337" y2="19" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="350" cy="15" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="347" y1="15" x2="353" y2="15" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="363" y="9" width="21" height="11" rx="2.5" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="365" y="11" width="15" height="7" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="385" y="12" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Back control -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="32,61 22,71 32,81" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="23" y1="71" x2="45" y2="71" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Account creation content -->
  <g>
    <text x="26" y="127" font-family="Gotham Medium, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="34" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">My number is</text>
    <text x="27" y="169" font-family="Gotham Book, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Country</text>
    <text x="363" y="169" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham Book, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">⌄</text>
    <line x1="26" y1="181" x2="364" y2="181" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="1.5"/>

    <text x="27" y="224" font-family="Gotham Book, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Phone number</text>
    <line x1="26" y1="236" x2="364" y2="236" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="1.5"/>

    <text x="27" y="263" font-family="Gotham Light, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="300" fill="#939393">We'll use your number to create your account.</text>

    <g>
      <rect x="90" y="291" width="210" height="44" rx="62" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
      <text x="195" y="319" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham Bold, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#939393">CONTINUE</text>
    </g>

    <text x="195" y="378" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham Light, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="300" fill="#939393">By tapping Continue, you agree to our</text>
    <text x="195" y="397" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham Medium, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Terms and Privacy Policy.</text>

    <line x1="26" y1="432" x2="364" y2="432" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="195" y="463" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham Book, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Your phone number stays private.</text>
    <text x="195" y="484" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham Light, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="300" fill="#939393">It will only be used to verify your account.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Native numeric keypad -->
  <rect x="0" y="553" width="390" height="291" fill="#F2F2F6"/>
  <g filter="url(#keyShadow)">
    <rect x="8" y="566" width="118" height="54" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
    <rect x="136" y="566" width="118" height="54" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
    <rect x="264" y="566" width="118" height="54" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>

    <rect x="8" y="627" width="118" height="54" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
    <rect x="136" y="627" width="118" height="54" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
    <rect x="264" y="627" width="118" height="54" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>

    <rect x="8" y="688" width="118" height="54" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
    <rect x="136" y="688" width="118" height="54" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
    <rect x="264" y="688" width="118" height="54" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>

    <rect x="8" y="749" width="118" height="54" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
    <rect x="136" y="749" width="118" height="54" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
    <rect x="264" y="749" width="118" height="54" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
  </g>

  <g>
    <text x="67" y="595" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="25" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">1</text>
    <text x="195" y="595" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="25" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">2</text>
    <text x="195" y="610" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">ABC</text>
    <text x="323" y="595" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="25" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">3</text>
    <text x="323" y="610" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">DEF</text>

    <text x="67" y="656" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="25" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">4</text>
    <text x="67" y="671" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">GHI</text>
    <text x="195" y="656" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="25" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">5</text>
    <text x="195" y="671" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">JKL</text>
    <text x="323" y="656" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="25" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">6</text>
    <text x="323" y="671" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">MNO</text>

    <text x="67" y="717" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="25" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">7</text>
    <text x="67" y="732" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">PQRS</text>
    <text x="195" y="717" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="25" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">8</text>
    <text x="195" y="732" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">TUV</text>
    <text x="323" y="717" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="25" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">9</text>
    <text x="323" y="732" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">WXYZ</text>

    <text x="195" y="778" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="25" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">0</text>
    <text x="323" y="779" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="400" fill="#4A4A4A">⌫</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Native bottom navigation / home indicator -->
  <rect x="151" y="827" width="88" height="5" rx="101" fill="#000000"/>
</svg>
